hooks.command:
# Auxiliary example only. install.sh does not install this hook automatically. Read-only isolation is required to block indirect writes.
cat >/dev/null; printf '%s\n' '{"decision":"deny","reason":"read-only"}'

cat >/dev/null; printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Check the frozen contract before git fetch/pull/switch, git push or gh pr. Do not read external tool source across workspace boundaries. This is an auxiliary reminder; read-only isolation enforces the boundary."}'
